_about.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 HIGH baseline — organization-defined parameters
_about.source: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 catalog v5.2.0, NIST HIGH baseline profile
_about.how_to_use: Set `value` (parameters) or `selected` (selections, an array of choices) for the entries you have decided, then send this file unchanged to PUT /api/v1/profile_documents/:id/parameters, or upload it to .../parameters/import/preview and .../import/confirm. Entries left null are skipped; "" or [] clears a stored value. Every other key is reference and is ignored.
